g.text: Arrows summarize branching and movement across deep time. Their overlap does not imply simultaneous populations

svg.title: Ancestry and dispersal of Erde
svg.desc: Ancient human and hobbit populations branch and move between continental and island habitats. Equal-area view. Arrows combine movements from different periods. Shared ancestry and overlapping routes do not establish one culture or a political boundary.
